about: The Student Mental Health Hub's own events, one record each; every record shown becomes a page at its address (src/render/hubevents.mjs). On the staff page, the Hub Events part is where events are made and changed; a saved event there is kept whole in the structure document and wins over the record here with its id. The Open House recap below is the first event, carried over word for word from the page file it replaced.

body: A look back at the Student Mental Health Hub Open House on Friday, September 25, 2026.
Past event hours: 12:00 PM–8:00 PM at 333 E. Campus Mall, Room 3203.
events.description: Snacks, therapy dogs, crafts, & FUN! At the second semesterly Student Mental Health Hub Open House, students explored the space & learned how to get involved in peer support!

topics.text: A therapy-dog visit was part of the Open House.
Button and ribbon making were among the activities.
The event offered cow and cheese stress toys, mini ducks, and Snoopy stickers.
A communal art activity was offered.
Resource Referral Cards and Navigating Housing in Madison toolkit materials were available.
Visitors could learn about Badger Supports, the American Foundation for Suicide Prevention, and ways to get involved.
